GPU bind_cols implementation

Source: R/bind.R
bind_cols_gpu.Rd

Sizes follow vctrs' rules (vctrs::vec_size_common()): inputs of size 1 recycle, every other size must match, and an input with no columns contributes its size only. A lazy input is computed once, so its size is the post-op row count.

Usage

bind_cols_gpu(dots, .name_repair = "unique", call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

dots

Inputs as flattened by bind_cols_inputs(): tbl_gpu, data frames and vectors (a vector becomes one column, named by its element name)

.name_repair

Name repair method

call

The user's call, for errors

Value

A tbl_gpu
